text:
Amanda (Support): FYI SUP-4321 — customer ACME hitting CI failure after upgrading our Go SDK to the v2 tag. Error they pasted below. can someone look?

Kevin (ACME): `go: github.com/redwood/inference-go@v2.0.1: module declares its path "github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2", but was required as "github.com/redwood/inference-go"` CI uses our private GOPROXY, they also have a `replace` pointing to a local path in their repo.

Raj (Eng): sounds like the classic major-version import mismatch. If the module's go.mod has `module github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2` then downstream imports and requires must use `/v2`. Check their code for `import "github.com/redwood/inference-go"` vs `import "github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2"`.

Amanda (Support): they added this in their go.mod: `replace github.com/redwood/inference-go => ../inference-go` — i think that replace is wrong for v2 modules. they should `replace github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2 => ../inference-go` or better avoid replace in CI.

Kevin (ACME): switching to `/v2` imports fixed local `go build`, but CI still fails with a checksum mismatch when downloading v2.0.1 from the proxy: `verifying github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2@v2.0.1: checksum mismatch` — they run `go env GOPROXY` -> `https://proxy.golang.org,direct`.

Olivia (Eng-Release): ugh. We force-pushed tag `v2.0.1` last week to adjust a commit (bad policy). That will produce a different module zip and hence checksum mismatch for anyone who already fetched the original tag. We should never rewrite published tags.

Raj (Eng): long-term: never force-push tags for released modules. Short-term: easiest path is to publish a new patch release (v2.0.2) pointing to the correct commit and ask the customer to `require github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2 v2.0.2` (and `go clean -modcache` if needed).

Olivia (Eng-Release): I'll cut v2.0.2 now and push it. steps I'm running: 1) `git tag v2.0.2 <commit-sha>` 2) `git push origin v2.0.2` 3) create GH release. we cannot remove the old mismatched tag from the public proxy cache; we must publish a new, non-conflicting tag.

release-bot: Release created: github.com/redwood/inference-go/v2 v2.0.2 — https://github.com/redwood/inference-go/releases/tag/v2.0.2 :white_check_mark:

Amanda (Support): Thanks team — telling ACME to update to v2.0.2 and to remove any `replace` in CI. will follow up if they still see errors. :thumbsup:

Kevin (ACME): ok thanks, will try now and report back within their CI run (~15m). appreciate the quick patch.

Olivia (Eng-Release): also adding a release-note and a small doc entry on our release checklist so we don't force-push tags again.

Raj (Eng): optional debugging tip for others: when you see a checksum mismatch, check `git ls-remote --tags origin` and confirm tag commit vs what your proxy is serving; force-pushing tags is a common root cause.

Amanda (Support): closing loop here unless ACME reopens. SUP-4321 -> set to resolved pending CI confirmation.
__notes: thread contains root message + replies; messages are short/slack-style; includes code snippets and a release-bot message
